sections.text:
This document outlines the 
major maintenance procedures P1, to be performed every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title block

The low pressure steam turbine 
is a part of the steam turbine matrix which is used in generating electricity. 
It uses the steam that comes from HRSG as a working medium in its operation. The 
LP turbine rotor consists of 4 stages.

The first draft is initiated by 
eng. Mohamed Abdel Azeem, tested by eng. Zakareya Radhwan, reviewed by eng. 
Ahmed Fathy, EDEPC revised by inspection and quality control at eng Abouda 
Elbanna, approved by general manager eng. Mohamed Anan, accepted by head sector 
president eng. Mohamed Elsarrag .

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman: 
 EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director, and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.

items:
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs etc.

Be sure that the turbine is 
 out of service and turning gear is off.

Be sure that all 
 electrical & instrumentation cables are completely isolated.

Be sure that the fire fighting 
 system is isolated.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Set of wires.
Cleaning articles.

Fillers, Vibrometeres, dial 
 gauges and slip gauges.

Special tools for clamping the 
 rotor.

Hydraulic pump for unbolting 
 the couplings.

Before Disassembly, you must record all 
 measurements of the unit during normal operation.

Stop and isolate oil system, 
 cooling system, fire fighting system, electric connections and turning gear.

Dismantle the connecting pipes 
 between LP and HP upper casing.
Break the cement insulation.

Remove the thermal wood 
 insulation.

Remove the screws fixing the 
 turning gear on bearing block.
Sling the turning gear.
Remove the turning gear.

Disassemble the turning gear 
 motor to be checked.

Disassemble the turning gear, 
 inspect its components and replace the damaged.

Dismantle the upper cover of 
 bearing pedestal.

Check the runout of the two 
 couplings (HP LP & LP G) (tightened couplings).

Uncouple the LP / HP rotors 
 and LP / Gen rotors. Use a hydraulic pump to unbolt the two couplings bolts.

Check the runout of the two 
 couplings (HP LP & LP G) (loosen couplings).

Check the alignment between 
 the (HP LP & LP G) couplings.

Unbolt the bolts and nuts of 
 the turbine casing by heating (unbolt 2 bolts and let 1). We use two types of 
 heating plugs (Large 23V 2250W 40A) & (Small 23V 7500W 20A).

Remove the screws & bolts 
 fixing bearing No, 3 bearing block cap on the lower bearing block.

Remove the screws & bolts 
 fixing bearing No, 4 bearing block cap on the lower bearing block.

Disassemble the two bearings 
 blocks caps fitted with the rotor groundings.

Remove the screws &bolts 
 fixing journal bearing straps.

Remove the journal bearing 
 strap.

Remove the two supports fitted 
 with their sensors.
Dismantle the thermocouple.

Remove the upper half journal 
 bearing.

Measure the clearances of the 
 bearing straps.

Dismantle the oil supply 
 connection from the rotor jacking.

Disassemble bearing No, 4 as 
 mentioned for bearing No, 3.

Unbolt the remain bolts and 
 nuts of the turbine casing as mentioned before.

Sling the turbine upper 
 casing.

Make sure that the disassembly 
 posts are installed.

Lift the upper casing by 1 mm, 
 using extraction screws.

Raise the upper casing slowly 
 with the crane, keeping it horizontally until it leaves the posts.

Lay the casing on the provided 
 area.

Suppress the screws and bolts 
 locking at the joint and remove the bolts.

Install the eyebolts in the 
 holes tapped for this purpose.

Sling and pull upwards to 
 loose the horizontal joints with a screwdriver used as a wedge.

Once the joint is released, 
 lift the upper part without leaving the centerline.

Measure the rotor axial & 
 radial clearances and record them.

Check the rotor runout by dial 
 indicator (the limit is 0.7 mm).

Measure the clearances of the 
 steam seal straps.

Sling the rotor at the given 
 locations (the rotor is lifted by 2 mm).

Make sure that the slings are 
 correctly stretched.

Lift the rotor at very low 
 speed and right in the axis, so that it doesn't touch any part.

Lay the rotor on the prepared 
 cradle supports.

Check and adjust the alignment 
 of diaphragms.

Sling the 1/2 packing 
 carriers using two eyebolts screwed in holes specially tapped at the joint.

Remove the keys securing 
 screws at the joint.

Lift the half packing. 
 Remove the keys. After they are released from the turbine horizontal joint, 
 remove the packing.

Disassemble the pin if it is 
 necessary, in that case, correctly mark the flat parts orientation.

Disassemble the inlet and 
 outlet half packings by slinging them and rotating them in their own 
 housings.

Sling the lower part of the 
 bearing by using two eyebolts in the distinct position.

Lift the lower part of the 
 bearing by rotating it in its own housing.

Dismantle the lower part of 
 bearing No, 4 as mentioned for the bearing No, 3.

Degrease all turbine parts 
 (turbine casing, turbine cover, bearing blocks,.) with non corrosive product 
 and rags.

Clean carefully all the LP 
 turbine parts with adequate products and solvents.

Clean all screws, pins and 
 nuts by solar.

Clean all steam seal segments 
 by solar.

sections.text:
Examine visually the turbine 
 components of wear, cracks, deformations, foreign bodies ... etc

items:
Check the sliding planes 
 condition by N.D.T for wear, cracks, .. .

Check the journal bearings 
 surface condition by N.D.T for wear, cracks, .. .

Check the journal bearings 
 mating - faces by N.D.T for wear, cracks, .. .

Check the separation of the 
 journal bearings by N.D.T.

Inspect the diaphragms by 
 magnetic test.

Inspect the steam seal 
 segments by penetration.

Inspect the rotor and its 
 blades by magnetic test.

Check the elongation of the 
 turbine bolts.

Cover the coupling, journal 
 bearings and seal stripes to prevent them from damage.
Sand blast the turbine shaft.

Sand blast the upper and lower 
 diaphragms.

Sand blast the steam seal 
 segments.

Sand blast all the bolts, 
 screws and nuts of the turbine (cover thread).

Before the assembly, you must 
 coat the mating faces, pins, keys and screws active faces with COPASLIP.

Pull the packings into the 
 diaphragm, each in its marked position after putting the springs in their 
 places.

Screw the packings in the 
 diaphragm.

Pull down the lower diaphragms 
 in their places.

Put the keys lock the 
 diaphragms into the horizontal joint.

Screws the bolts to lock the 
 keys.

Make the blue test between the 
 turbine lower part and the bearings pedestals to actuate the surfaces of 
 contact.

Pull down the lower part of 
 the bearing in its grooved place.

Tight the screws fix the lower 
 part with the pedestal.

Assemble the lower part of 
 bearing No. 4 as mentioned for bearing No. 3.

Put lead wires on the lower 
 diaphragms.
Lift the rotor.

Put the rotor very slowly till 
 it rests in its position.

Raise the rotor again and 
 measure the clearances between it and the turbine casing.

Put the rotor very slowly till 
 it rests in its position again.

Measure the all radial & axial 
 clearances using a filler and record these readings.
Sling the turbine cover.

Paint the lower part of the 
 turbine with special recommended paint to make the blue test that used to 
 actuate the surfaces of contact of the two halves of the turbine.

Put the turbine cover using 
 its four guides on the lower part of the turbine to execute that test.

Raise the turbine cover again 
 and remark the result of the test.

Assemble the upper diaphragms 
 packings as done for the packings of the lower diaphragms.

Put the upper diaphragms in 
 their places and lock them by screws.

Put the turbine cover again as 
 mentioned before.

Screw the bolts of the turbine 
 cover (bolt 2 and let 1).

Check and adjust the alignment 
 between LP / HP and LP / Generator shafts with slip gauges and dial gauges 
 (loosen couplings).

Measure and adjust the 
 clearances of the journal bearings before assembly.

Put the upper part of the 
 bearing on the rotor and tight it.

Assemble the upper part of 
 bearing No, 4 and its casing as mentioned in bearing No, 3.

Connect all steam junctions 
 between LP / HP turbines and fix them.

Bolt the coupling between LP / 
 HP turbines and LP / Gen shafts.

Bolt the turbine cover bolts 
 by heating.
Sling the turning gear.

Put the turning gear in its 
 place.

Tight the screws fixing the 
 turning gear on bearing block.

Assemble the turning gear 
 motor and fix it.

Cover the turbine with glass 
 wool and then with thermal cement.

Introduction
This document outlines the 
major maintenance procedures P1, to be performed every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title block
The low pressure steam turbine 
is a part of the steam turbine matrix which is used in generating electricity. 
It uses the steam that comes from HRSG as a working medium in its operation. The 
LP turbine rotor consists of 4 stages.
Technical Specifications
The first draft is initiated by 
eng. Mohamed Abdel Azeem, tested by eng. Zakareya Radhwan, reviewed by eng. 
Ahmed Fathy, EDEPC revised by inspection and quality control at eng Abouda 
Elbanna, approved by general manager eng. Mohamed Anan, accepted by head sector 
president eng. Mohamed Elsarrag .
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman: 
 EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director, and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precaution
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs etc.
Be sure that the turbine is 
 out of service and turning gear is off.
Be sure that all 
 electrical & instrumentation cables are completely isolated.
Be sure that the fire fighting 
 system is isolated.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Set of wires.
Cleaning articles.
Fillers, Vibrometeres, dial 
 gauges and slip gauges.
Special tools for clamping the 
 rotor.
Hydraulic pump for unbolting 
 the couplings.
Work to be Carried out

Stop and isolate oil system, 
 cooling system, fire fighting system, electric connections and turning gear.
Disassembly
Dismantle the connecting pipes 
 between LP and HP upper casing.
Break the cement insulation.
Remove the thermal wood 
 insulation.
Remove the screws fixing the

Sling the turning gear.
Remove the turning gear.
Disassemble the turning gear 
 motor to be checked.
Disassemble the turning gear, 
 inspect its components and replace the damaged.
Dismantle the upper cover of

Check the runout of the two

Uncouple the LP / HP rotors 
 and LP / Gen rotors. Use a hydraulic pump to unbolt the two couplings bolts.
Check the runout of the two 
 couplings (HP LP & LP G) (loosen couplings).
Check the alignment between 
 the (HP LP & LP G) couplings.
Unbolt the bolts and nuts of 
 the turbine casing by heating (unbolt 2 bolts and let 1). We use two types of 
 heating plugs (Large 23V 2250W 40A) & (Small 23V 7500W 20A).
Remove the screws & bolts 
 fixing bearing No, 3 bearing block cap on the lower bearing block.
Remove the screws & bolts 
 fixing bearing No, 4 bearing block cap on the lower bearing block.
Disassemble the two bearings 
 blocks caps fitted with the rotor groundings.
Remove the screws &bolts 
 fixing journal bearing straps.
Remove the journal bearing 
 strap.
Remove the two supports fitted 
 with their sensors.
Dismantle the thermocouple.
Remove the upper half journal 
 bearing.
Measure the clearances of the 
 bearing straps.
Dismantle the oil supply 
 connection from the rotor jacking.
Disassemble bearing No, 4 as 
 mentioned for bearing No, 3.
Unbolt the remain bolts and 
 nuts of the turbine casing as mentioned before.
Sling the turbine upper 
 casing.
Make sure that the disassembly 
 posts are installed.
Lift the upper casing by 1 mm, 
 using extraction screws.
Raise the upper casing slowly 
 with the crane, keeping it horizontally until it leaves the posts.
Lay the casing on the provided

Suppress the screws and bolts 
 locking at the joint and remove the bolts.
Install the eyebolts in the

Sling and pull upwards to 
 loose the horizontal joints with a screwdriver used as a wedge.
Once the joint is released, 
 lift the upper part without leaving the centerline.
Measure the rotor axial & 
 radial clearances and record them.
Check the rotor runout by dial

Measure the clearances of the

Sling the rotor at the given

Make sure that the slings are

Lift the rotor at very low

Lay the rotor on the prepared

Check and adjust the alignment 
 of diaphragms.
Sling the 1/2 packing

Remove the keys securing

Lift the half packing. 
 Remove the keys. After they are released from the turbine horizontal joint, 
 remove the packing.
Disassemble the pin if it is 
 necessary, in that case, correctly mark the flat parts orientation.
Disassemble the inlet and 
 outlet half packings by slinging them and rotating them in their own 
 housings.
Sling the lower part of the 
 bearing by using two eyebolts in the distinct position.
Lift the lower part of the 
 bearing by rotating it in its own housing.
Dismantle the lower part of 
 bearing No, 4 as mentioned for the bearing No, 3.
Inspection
Cleaning
Degrease all turbine parts 
 (turbine casing, turbine cover, bearing blocks,.) with non corrosive product 
 and rags.
Clean carefully all the LP 
 turbine parts with adequate products and solvents.
Clean all screws, pins and 
 nuts by solar.
Clean all steam seal segments 
 by solar.
Visual examination
Examine visually the turbine 
 components of wear, cracks, deformations, foreign bodies ... etc
Checking the 
Bearing Blocks
Check the sliding planes 
 condition by N.D.T for wear, cracks, .. .
Check the journal bearings 
 surface condition by N.D.T for wear, cracks, .. .
Check the journal bearings 
 mating - faces by N.D.T for wear, cracks, .. .
Check the separation of the 
 journal bearings by N.D.T.
NDT Inspection
Inspect the diaphragms by 
 magnetic test.
Inspect the steam seal 
 segments by penetration.
Inspect the rotor and its 
 blades by magnetic test.
Check the elongation of the 
 turbine bolts.
Sand Blasting
Cover the coupling, journal 
 bearings and seal stripes to prevent them from damage.
Sand blast the turbine shaft.
Sand blast the upper and lower 
 diaphragms.
Sand blast the steam seal 
 segments.
Sand blast all the bolts, 
 screws and nuts of the turbine (cover thread).
Assembly
Before the assembly, you must 
 coat the mating faces, pins, keys and screws active faces with COPASLIP.
Pull the packings into the 
 diaphragm, each in its marked position after putting the springs in their 
 places.
Screw the packings in the 
 diaphragm.
Pull down the lower diaphragms 
 in their places.
Put the keys lock the

Screws the bolts to lock the

Make the blue test between the

Pull down the lower part of

Tight the screws fix the lower

Put lead wires on the lower

Lift the rotor.
Put the rotor very slowly till

Paint the lower part of the

Put the upper diaphragms in 
 their places and lock them by screws.
Put the turbine cover again as 
 mentioned before.
Screw the bolts of the turbine 
 cover (bolt 2 and let 1).
Check and adjust the alignment 
 between LP / HP and LP / Generator shafts with slip gauges and dial gauges 
 (loosen couplings).
Measure and adjust the 
 clearances of the journal bearings before assembly.
Put the upper part of the 
 bearing on the rotor and tight it.
Assemble the upper part of 
 bearing No, 4 and its casing as mentioned in bearing No, 3.
Connect all steam junctions 
 between LP / HP turbines and fix them.
Bolt the coupling between LP / 
 HP turbines and LP / Gen shafts.
Bolt the turbine cover bolts 
 by heating.
Sling the turning gear.
Put the turning gear in its 
 place.
Tight the screws fixing the 
 turning gear on bearing block.
Assemble the turning gear 
 motor and fix it.
Cover the turbine with glass 
 wool and then with thermal cement.
Preparation of the Unit for Start Up
Be sure that all electrical & 
 instrumentation cables are completely connected.
Operate the fire fighting 
 system.
Operate the cooling system.
Operate the oil system.
Operate the turning gear and 
 check any noise and abnormal sound.
Attendance and Checking During Start up and Operation
Check the vibration on the 
 bearings.
Check the oil pressure.
Check the bearing temperature.
Check the vacuum in condenser.
